documentation_overlay.identity_resolution: The containing W1 documentation commit, supplied as an exact SHA/URL in the final delivery handoff. In a clean checkout use git rev-parse HEAD and confirm its sole parent is frozen_source_revision; do not substitute E4 for the overlay. No circular self-embedded commit identity.

proposed_future_R0_release.identity_assignment: Future explicit Primary release decision only; W1 overlay is not an accepted release.

authentication_policy.git_identity: commit_sha1/tree_sha1/git_blob_sha1 fields identify Git objects, not file SHA-256. commit_object_sha256 hashes raw commit-object payload bytes; actual_sha256 hashes ordinary artifact bytes.
authentication_policy.available_authenticated: Accessible bytes agree with exact Git object identity or a digest authenticated by an inspected committed historical inventory.
authentication_policy.available_not_fully_authenticated: Bytes accessible and hashed; historical binding is absent or only in a local unanchored record.
authentication_policy.missing: Specified historical file was checked at its literal recorded location and is absent. Does not mean it ever existed.
authentication_policy.unverified_inaccessible: No independently checked artifact bytes or no retrievable exact environment/archive identity. Null existence/accessibility is unknown, not false.
authentication_policy.remote_scope: Remote release/performance-synthetic-v1 was queried and matched E4. Full fresh independent Git clone and all remote distribution/archive retrievals were not performed.
authentication_policy.scope_limit: Hashes establish byte identity, not capture provenance, behavior, runtime success or physical validity.

source_inventory.comparison: All 294 recorded SHA-256 values match bytes at the worker Git revision and frozen E4; all four retained case input inventories equal the literal 294-entry map.
source_inventory.entries: committed_artifacts records with roles containing scientific_source_inventory
